response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack web developer with strong software craftsmanship, but the resume shows no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, GPU/accelerator work, or deep-learning performance optimization — the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. His experience is centered on web platforms (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than hardware-software co-design or AI accelerator performance analysis.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience, meeting the years-of-experience bar
Some low-latency systems work (async I/O, fibers, high-throughput services at Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and open-source/community contributions
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or silicon design experience
No deep-learning workload, GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or accelerator performance background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not principal-level performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI/deep-learning workload or GPU expertise
General seniority and systems programming exposure
